name: News Clip
description: Turn a topic into a short AI news video.
trigger: make a short news video / clip about a topic

inputs.name: topic
inputs.prompt: What topic should the clip cover?

steps.label: Find the latest (multiple sources)
steps.instruction: Run 2-4 searches with varied queries using brave-search (its search parameter is `q`; optionally serper too) to gather solid, recent facts on the topic — don't rely on a single search.

steps.label: Write a 6-second script
steps.instruction: From the results, write a punchy ~20-word script for a 6-second clip plus a one-line visual description. Reason this out yourself — no service call.

steps.label: Generate the video
steps.instruction: Generate a short video from the script and visual description. It returns a job; the runtime polls it until ready.

steps.label: Show it
steps.instruction: Surface the finished video to the user along with the script.
